title: Settings
themeDescription: Choose a color theme for the platform.
languageDescription: Choose the language used across the platform.
demoDescription: Populate the platform with synthetic data for screenshots and demos. Real challenges and labs are kept; activity data (scores, events, teams, notifications) is faked.
demoBannerOn: Demo mode is ON — all activity data is synthetic
demoReloadNote: Toggling will reload the page. Disable to return to live data.
navigationDescription: Drag to reorder pages, or hide ones you don't use. Hidden pages can be shown again at any time.
